study: V21 10-portfolio original + HARD SL retrade simulation
policy: Each leg sets absolute stop at entry quoted price +/- percent; intrabar M5 bid_low/ask_high; gap executed at worse M5 opening quote; 1bp slippage each way; if not triggered, fixed timed exit.
conservative: Stops may close earlier, but original fixed-hold entry spacing is retained. Other bots are independent and can overlap.
limitations: M5 OHLC cannot prove exact tick order, partial 5-minute bars may hide worse real fill
No swap/commission/funding, SL liquidity effects or margin
Partial November: only exits before UTC 2026-11-12 18:00
Backtest dates 2025 to 2026-10 were used for discovery, high overfitting risk
